# 4-Day Lisbon Family Trip Plan

A relaxed Lisbon plan for **2 adults + 1 child (8)** from **2026-04-10 to 2026-04-13**, centered in **Baixa/Chiado** with easy walking, tram access, and vegetarian-friendly meals. Budget target of **€1,800 total** is workable with one mid-range family hotel and mostly casual dining.

## Best Kid-Friendly Stay and Daily Plan

### Recommended Hotel: Baixa/Chiado Base
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/building.svg
- Best fit: family-friendly, central, walkable, and convenient for trams, riverfront, and downtown sights.
- Look for: 1 family room or 2 connecting rooms, elevator, breakfast included, and air conditioning.
- Good area picks: **Baixa**, **Chiado**, or the edge of **Cais do Sodré** if it is still walkable to the center.

### Day 1: Baixa + Riverside First Look
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/geo-alt.svg
- Morning: Arrive, check in, and take an easy walk through **Praça do Comércio** and **Rua Augusta**.
- Afternoon: Ride the **Santa Justa area** and explore nearby squares at a slow pace.
- Food: Vegetarian lunch at a casual café in Baixa; look for soup, grilled cheese, salad, or vegetable risotto.
- Evening: Early dinner and an optional short walk along the river.

### Day 2: Tram, Castle Views, and Old Lisbon
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/train-front.svg
- Morning: Take **Tram 28** or a similar short tram ride, then visit **São Jorge Castle** if everyone feels up for it.
- Afternoon: Wander the **Alfama** streets and stop for a scenic viewpoint.
- Food: Vegetarian-friendly lunch with pasta, pizza, or petiscos-style small plates.
- Evening: Return to Chiado for a low-key dinner and dessert.

### Day 3: Belém for Easy Family Sightseeing
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/water.svg
- Morning: Head to **Belém Tower** area and the riverfront for open space and photos.
- Afternoon: Visit **Jerónimos Monastery** exterior or nearby gardens, then stop at the **MAAT** area if energy is good.
- Food: Lunch in Belém with vegetarian pastries, sandwiches, or a sit-down café meal.
- Evening: Try a relaxed dinner back in Baixa/Chiado.

### Day 4: Park Time + Souvenir Stroll
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/tree.svg
- Morning: Spend time at **Eduardo VII Park** or a similar open green space for a slower start.
Media: Alt=Morning: Spend time at **Eduardo VII Park** or a similar open green space for a slower start, Lisbon, Portugal
- Afternoon: Final shopping stroll in **Chiado** and **Rossio** for souvenirs and snacks.
- Food: Simple vegetarian lunch before departure, then grab takeaway snacks if needed.
- Evening: Depart or enjoy one last early dinner if your flight is later.

## Cost Breakdown for 3 People

| Category | Estimate | Notes |
|---|---:|---|
| Hotel, 3 nights | €720 | Mid-range family stay in Baixa/Chiado |
| Meals | €420 | Breakfasts, lunches, dinners, snacks |
| Local transport | €90 | Metro, tram, occasional taxi/Uber |
| Attractions | €180 | Castle, monastery area, tram rides, viewpoints |
| Contingency | €150 | Extra snacks, museum upgrade, taxi buffer |
| Total | **€1,560** | Leaves about **€240** cushion |

## Budget-Friendly Trip Notes

- Keep **one paid attraction per day** at most; Lisbon is strong on walkable sights and viewpoints.
- Choose a hotel with **breakfast included** to save time and money.
- For the child, mix in **trams, viewpoints, parks, and river walks** so the trip stays fun without overpacking the schedule.
- Vegetarian food is easy to find in central Lisbon: look for **sopa**, **saladas**, **massa**, **risotto**, **tostas**, and **vegetarian petiscos**.

## Quick Actions
